purpose: Separate the effect of iterative abstraction/consolidation from the effect of the retention/eviction rule in a compact persistent Lean lemma library, and compare cheap usage-based retention with causal future-task marginal-utility gating without future leakage.

evidence_motivation.dreamprover: DreamProver shows large system-level gains from iterative wake-sleep library optimization and real cross-task reuse, but its ablation does not isolate the usage-based/LRU forgetting rule from abstraction, clustering, consolidation, and changed library contents.
evidence_motivation.existing_guard: Usage/retrieval/proof-dependency/coalition credit remain advisory. Chronologically future fixed-compute counterfactual proving is the authoritative promotion/demotion evidence.

frozen_primary_design.model_and_decoding: same pinned prover/model, tokenizer, temperature, sampling seed schedule and verifier across conditions
frozen_primary_design.environment: same pinned Lean/toolchain/project snapshot across conditions
frozen_primary_design.retrieval: same retriever, candidate universe, top-k and serialization across all conditions in which retrieval is enabled
frozen_primary_design.candidate_generation: same generated verified candidate pool within each chronological fold; candidate generation is not rerun separately per retention condition
frozen_primary_design.library_serialization: deterministic; when entry and token caps conflict, retain policy-ranked entries in deterministic tie-break order until both caps are satisfied
frozen_primary_design.authoritative_comparison: total-system-cost matched. Policy-selection overhead counts against the condition's budget; a secondary proof-budget-matched view may be reported only as a diagnostic.

chronological_split.unit: rolling chronological folds within a domain/repository
per_fold: G_i: generation window. Generate and kernel-verify candidate lemmas using only G_i and earlier state.
S_i: scoring/admission window strictly later than G_i. Usage statistics and causal marginal-utility estimates may use S_i, and S_i is consumed after scoring.

E_i: evaluation window strictly later than S_i. Primary solve/cost metrics are computed here; no E_i information may affect promotion, eviction, retrieval ranking, thresholds, or policy parameters for that fold.
chronological_split.leakage_rule: No theorem, proof, dependency, retrieval trace, or outcome from S_i/E_i may influence candidate generation in G_i. No E_i information may influence library selection for E_i.

conditions.description: Base prover with no learned persistent lemma library.

conditions.abstraction: verified candidates available only in staged pool
conditions.description: Verified generated candidates can be retrieved on demand but are not globally promoted.
Control for persistent capacity without usage or causal scoring.
Isolates abstraction/consolidation benefit under a neutral retention rule.

conditions.abstraction: same fixed clustered/abstracted/consolidated candidate producer as C4/C6/C7
conditions.description: DreamProver-like cheap usage prior under fixed abstraction.

conditions.abstraction: same fixed clustered/abstracted/consolidated candidate producer as C4/C5/C7
conditions.description: Promotion/demotion uses paired fixed-compute proving on S_i; selection overhead is charged to total system cost.

conditions.abstraction: same fixed clustered/abstracted/consolidated candidate producer as C4/C5/C6
conditions.retention: usage/generalization/reprovability/support priors shortlist candidates, then causal marginal-utility gate
conditions.description: Tests whether cheap advisory priors can reduce causal-evaluation overhead without sacrificing E_i utility.

causal_gate_v0.comparison: paired library-on versus library-off (or retained-set versus candidate-removed) proof attempts under identical task, model, decoding seed, verifier and per-task compute
primary_effects: delta verified solve probability / solved count
delta total system cost per verified solve
pollution_costs: new failures or timeouts on tasks solved by the paired control
causal_gate_v0.authority: only this future-task matched counterfactual evidence may authorize causal promotion/demotion; cheap priors cannot widen authority

primary_metrics: actual proof-term dependency use of library lemmas
explicit tactic reference use, reported separately
covered solved tasks with at least one library use
demotion regret: a demoted lemma later shows positive matched counterfactual utility on a subsequent scoring window
negative transfer: paired tasks lost relative to control

planned_pairwise_interpretation.C4_vs_C5: usage retention effect with fixed abstraction
planned_pairwise_interpretation.C4_vs_C6: causal gate versus neutral retention under fixed abstraction
planned_pairwise_interpretation.C5_vs_C6: causal gate versus usage retention under fixed abstraction
planned_pairwise_interpretation.C6_vs_C7: whether cheap priors reduce causal-gate overhead without losing downstream utility
planned_pairwise_interpretation.C0_vs_C1: query-only staged candidate value without global promotion

sensitivity.rule: capacity sensitivity is secondary and may be run only after the primary K=96 matrix; it must not replace the primary result based on observed outcomes

completion_criterion: This preregistration is complete only as a design artifact. It is not evidence that any policy is superior and does not change the global lemma library.
